user.title: Add an Area Concierge
user.description: Give one Area its own AI chat. Requests typed to it are scoped to that Area only. It uses one of your existing Assist Pipelines (Settings → Voice assistants) - nothing else to set up.

data_description.area_id: The Area this concierge lives in. Each Area can have one.
data_description.pipeline_id: Its conversation agent, speech-to-text and text-to-speech voice all come from this pipeline.
data_description.name: Leave blank to use the Area's name followed by "Concierge".

error.area_not_found: That Area no longer exists. Pick another one.
error.area_taken: This Area already has a Concierge.

abort.already_configured: This Area already has a Concierge.
abort.no_pipelines: No Assist Pipelines were found. Create one first under Settings → Voice assistants.

data_description.pipeline_id: Changing this reloads the concierge. Its chat history is kept.
data_description.max_messages: When the chat log gets longer than this, the oldest messages quietly drop off.
data_description.scope_to_area: On: this Area's name is added to your message automatically, so "turn off the lights" only affects this Area. Off: your message is sent as-is, so you can name a different Area or entity directly.
